records.name: mail.group.member.view.list
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <list editable="top" sample="1">
                <header>
                    <button name="%(mail_group.mail_compose_message_action_mail_group)d" type="action" string="Email"/>
                </header>
                <field name="email" force_save="1" required="1" readonly="partner_id"/>
                <field name="email_normalized" column_invisible="True" force_save="1"/>
                <field name="partner_id"/>
                <field name="mail_group_id"/>
            </list>
        </field>

records.name: mail.group.member.view.search
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <search string="Search Mail Group Member">
                <field name="email" required="1"/>
                <field name="partner_id"/>
                <field name="mail_group_id"/>
            </search>
        </field>
